The image shows a single leaf with:
- Diffuse whitish/grayish powdery coating over the leaf surface
- The coating appears dusty and uniform across the leaf
- Small dark spots/specks scattered throughout
- The leaf retains its shape (no necrotic lesions, no cankers, no galls)
- The overall appearance is a matte, whitish-grey dusting on a green leaf

This is characteristic of **Powdery Mildew** — the white/grey powdery fungal growth on the leaf surface is the hallmark symptom, distinct from Sooty Mould (which is black/dark), Anthracnose (which causes dark necrotic lesions), or other options.
